intro: Leo's Loo Too pairs a fairly small drawer with a fussy taste in litter, and those two facts explain most of the questions owners ask. Its odour system has consumable parts too.

facts.text: Rated for cats from 1 to 20 lb, sensed by radar and four weight sensors.
The fully enclosed waste drawer holds 6 L (1.5 gallons).
Odour control combines UV with bamboo carbon filters.

symptoms.title: Waste is left behind after cycles
symptoms.summary: Cycles finish but leave waste in the bed, or clumps fall apart.
causes: Casa Leo recommends clumping clay litter; other types perform poorly.

fixes.detail: Switch to a clumping clay litter, as Casa Leo recommends.

symptoms.escalate: If cleaning stays poor on clumping clay, work through the common cycle steps.

symptoms.title: The drawer needs emptying often
symptoms.summary: The drawer fills sooner than with competing boxes.
causes: At 6 L, the drawer is smaller than most rivals'.

fixes.detail: Expect to empty it more often than a 10–13 L drawer, especially with more than one cat.

symptoms.escalate: If it fills unusually fast for one cat, check the litter is not overfilled.

symptoms.title: Smell builds up over time
symptoms.summary: Odour creeps back despite the UV system.
causes: The bamboo carbon filters are spent.

fixes.detail: Fit fresh bamboo carbon filters; UV alone does not replace them.

symptoms.escalate: If smell persists with new filters, work through the common odour steps.
